alt: First page of the formal written response from L.A. Care Health Plan dated July 13, 2026, returning older portions of the claim as untimely and denying/rejecting all other portions of the Government Tort Claim.
summary: This document represents Page 1 of the official written response from L.A. Care Health Plan to the formal Government Claim presented on May 28, 2026. Under reference number LMR-9059, Associate Counsel William Seldeen outlines that any claims accruing more than one year prior are returned as untimely under Government Code §§ 901 and 911.2, while timely presented portions are explicitly rejected and denied. Crucially, the document issues the formal six-month warning under Government Code § 945.6, thereby exhausting administrative remedies and clearing the path for the immediate refiling of the small claims litigation under Case 26AVSC00542.

July 13, 2026
VIA U.S. MAIL AND EMAIL

Nicolas Hernandez
[REDACTED CA 9...]

Re: L.A. Care Response to Government Claim
Claimant: Nicolas Hernandez
Respondent: L.A. Care Health Plan
Incident Date: April 26, 2026 and Others
Total Demand: $ 3,522.13
Date of Government Claim: May 28, 2026
L.A. Care Reference No.: LMR-9059
Claimant's Ref. No.: n/a

Dear Mr. Hernandez,

Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles County, operating and doing business as L.A. Care Health Plan ("L.A. Care"), was placed on notice of a Government Claim submitted by your office on behalf of Claimant on the date referenced above (the "Claim"). The Claim asserts that L.A. Care (i) failed to process (pay, contest, or deny) a reimbursement claim timely and (ii) otherwise failed to pay for Non-Medical Transportation.

RETURNED AS UNTIMELY

For any claims that accrued more than one year prior to the Date of the Government Claim stated above, the Claim is being returned as untimely because the Claim was not presented to L.A. Care within the required time period after the accrual for the cause(s) of action, as required by law. See Gov. Code §§ 901, 911.2. Because the Claim or a portion of the Claim was not presented within the time allowed by law, no action was taken on the Claim or portion thereof.

DENIAL OF CLAIM

Notice is hereby given that, to the extent that the Claim or any portion of the Claim was timely presented, it has been rejected by L.A. Care.

WARNING

Subject to certain exceptions, you have only six (6) months from the date this notice was personally delivered or deposited in the mail to file a court action on this claim with respect to those portions of the claim rejected herein. See Gov. Code § 945.6.

1200 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017 | lacare.org
A Public Entity Serving Los Angeles County
William Seldeen | Associate Counsel
213.694.1250 x6180 | wseldeen@lacare.org
